covered_report_window: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Wednesday, October 28, 2026 U.S. market close and before the Thursday, October 29, 2026 U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: The Federal Reserve decision and Chair press conference occur shortly before the after-close reports; Thursday 8:30 a.m. ET GDP, PCE, income/spending, and claims data can move index futures before the pre-market names open. Elevated oil and intense AI-capex scrutiny raise macro and valuation sensitivity.

consensus_method.description: Three fully independent evidence reviews used one fixed qualified universe. Direction scores and reversal-risk values are arithmetic means.
consensus_method.disparity_formula: 70% of the capped range of the three direction scores plus 30% of the range of the three reversal-risk scores; 0 means identical assessments and 100 indicates extreme disagreement.

learned_lessons_review.note: No new method change. Existing key-metric, premium-growth priced-in, low-bar reversal, and disparity rules were applied.
